purpose: Everything the survey asks of the walking controller, with numbers. Navigation sends only these commands. The accepted controller is judged only on the set it claims. No guide restates these values.

stage2_flat.ground: flat, level, obstacle-free; drawn exclusions are avoided by the route planner, not by the controller

stop.measured_against: the simulator's true root pose with the waypoint follower driving each route from the start pose; the body must end within position_tolerance_m of the last goal and stay there under a zero command for stay_stopped_s; src/locomotion/evaluation/requirements.py stop_position_m

stage2_flat.pose_source: Livox Mid-360 lidar-inertial odometry for local position and heading; GPS without RTK (3 m error bound) for the global frame

payload.note: Sensor only. Mount, cable and any compute or battery on the deck add to this mass and are not decided.

controller.measured_against: the simulator's true root pose against the path the command would trace, actor mean, one trial per case; src/locomotion/evaluation/requirements.py

sources.commands, hold_min_s, stop.position_tole: src/navigation/waypoint.py command bank and follower defaults, bound by src/navigation/tests/test_requirements.py
sources.tilt_max_deg: the retired scorer's TAIL maximum_tilt_degrees (src/locomotion/evaluation/scoring.py until a8d1a825, archive bound in configs/source_inventory.json); its 5 degree static-scenario bound was a diagnostic
sources.ground, pose_source: https://github.com/Cornell-Physical-Intelligence/hexapod-cupi/issues/20 (ground); program lead decision 2026-11-07 that the Mid-360 is the localization sensor (pose_source)
sources.stop.routes_m: program lead, 2026-11-08; goals in metres relative to the start pose in its forward frame, each route at most 0.9 m so one trial fits the 60 s native episode at the slowest speed plus the stay window and two settles
